kb_refs.claim: The diffusive time is the time a sphere needs to diffuse its own diameter, and it sets the shortest record length from which a mean squared displacement can be read.
The particles in the bottle in use have a diameter of 5 micrometres, with a coefficient of variation no greater than 2 per cent, measured directly by the operator on 2026-09-19.
The expected translational diffusivity of a tracer sphere in a bulk fluid is the Stokes-Einstein value, k_B T over 3 pi eta d. It is a prediction from the viscosity, the temperature and the diameter,

The number of Abvigen AFR-0500-COOH particles per millilitre of the as-supplied 10 mg/ml suspension is 6*C/(pi*rho*d**3), where C is the mass concentration, rho the particle density 1.03 g/cm3 and d t
The Abvigen AFR-0500-COOH particle material has a density of 1.03 g/cm3, which is independent of the diameter supplied.
The Abvigen AFR-0500-COOH product is supplied as a suspension at a mass concentration of 10 mg/ml, in volumes of 10 ml or 20 ml.
